description: Conceptual analysis task. Tests whether the output performs philosophy or summarises it.
task: Analyse the concept of consciousness as it functions in the debate over machine minds.
expected_moves: reconstructs at least one target position in its strongest form
distinguishes conceptual, empirical and normative claims
traces the genealogy of at least one contested term
states and answers the strongest objection
checks for equivocation across uses of 'consciousness'
must_not: produce a chronological survey of who said what
treat 'consciousness' as univocal across the argument
cite a commentator for a claim about a primary text
pass_condition: All expected moves present; rubric threshold met on every weighted dimension; zero must_not violations.
